svg.title: Adversarial manipulation of the declared identifier
svg.desc: Flow of 1202 process executions from the three adversarial conditions, through whether each correlated, to which principal was named.
svg.text: 1,202 process executions in the adversarial cell
Pooled across both forgery cells: 834 of 834 named the victim, none named the attacker.
Detection was unaffected. The forgery changed who was named, not whether the attack was seen.
